summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a non-binding letter of intent to acquire substantially all assets of Resmac, Inc. from RezyFi, Inc. via a newly formed South Dakota subsidiary. Total consideration is $5,000,000 in 2.5 million shares of SD Holdco Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at $2.00 stated value; no cash or Netcapital common stock. Terms remain subject to due diligence, regulatory approvals, board approval, and definitive agreement. Structurally, the consideration is all preferred equity in the acquisition vehicle, insulating Netcapital from dilution. The transaction may unlock mortgage origination capabilities. Watch for definitive agreement execution, regulatory clearances, and potential stock price dislocation from the preferred terms.
